api.input_policy: Readonly outer records with exclusive fields. Constructor signature and runtime semantics unchanged.
api.coordinates: Resource local y-up to stage y-up; node rect is explicit stage clip/layout viewport; source rectangles use top-left image pixels.
api.ownership: Define on content change, publish references/cheap transforms, remove only after successful tree replacement drops the last reference. Pure renderItem cannot define/remove.
api.limits: 256 resources; host quad/string budgets; 16 MiB encoded bytes per resource, 32 MiB registry.

completion.scope: Synchronous complete world/UI/cursor submissions. Not physical scanout. Query never ticks/pauses/decodes another world.

verification.core_unit_scope: Full Core run includes retained resources, encoded budgets and prefix hashing. Later type-only aliases and local-delta containment are covered separately by 28 typing outcomes and 8 final integration tests.

coverage.context_scope: Retained UI prefix and combined completed-presentation readiness/recovery

remaining_acceptance: Actual frozen-baseline game idle,drag,travel,atlas,battle: >=59 simulation ticks/s, RAF/s and completed submissions/s, p95<=18.5ms,p99<=25ms, no sustained dropped steps.
Longer actual-game CPU/GPU retention and JS/Luau GC measurements; short tests do not establish universal leak freedom.
Investigate ordinary-world geometry context-restore/delete warnings separately; retained UI ownership is already tested.
Do not use historical SDKcandidate1/2 for final acceptance; candidate3 fixes public type ergonomics and local containment.
